All effort and velocity limits are exporter defaults, not validated actuator limits.
CAD-to-controller coordinate signs, offsets and measured limit calibration remain unverified; the neck has no controller yet.
Jaw-to-jaw mimic relations exist, but gripper motor-radian-to-jaw-metre transmission is unverified.
Collision elements reuse detailed visual meshes; the active collision model does not include the head.
